notes: Read all 203 source lines with numbered output before editing. The web /settings page is a PageContainer(title, subtitle, loading) wrapping a settings-search box, a cross-tab edit-conflict banner, four sections (General/Appearance/Advanced/Reset), and three link/action cards (Data Export, Onboarding Tour, Setup Checklist), plus two browser-only effects and an edit-lease claim. Every DOM/web-only piece is replaced with a native-safe equivalent and each unavailable browser behaviour is surfaced explicitly via nativeSettingsPageCapabilities (parity rule 7).

L1 `useEffect` import: the two effects it powered are browser-only (URL hash + document + scrollIntoView + setTimeout), so no useEffect is needed natively; documented unavailable. L2 react-router useLocation/useNavigate -> no react-router on native; navigation surfaced via the optional onNavigate callback (reactRouterAvailable:false). L3 react-i18next useTranslation('settings') -> useNativeTranslationFallback returning each English fallback + reproducing i18next {{var}} interpolation.

L4 useSettings -> the existing native ../../../api/hooks/useSettings (same useQuery; the `{ isLoading }` destructure is preserved). L5 PageContainer -> inline PageContainerView (ScrollView + title/subtitle header; loading swaps the body for an ActivityIndicator, mirroring the web Spinner-vs-children behaviour). L6 GlassPanel/Button/IconBox -> shared native GlassPanel; Button(variant ghost, icon) -> inline GhostButton (Pressable + leading SemanticIcon + label); IconBox -> SemanticIcon glyphs. L7 FadeIn -> passthrough View (framer-motion entrance has no behavioural contract; delay accepted but inert). L8 usePageTitle -> no-op useNativePageTitle (no document.title on native; title still rendered).
